functions-for-retiring-the-legacy-comman.text: Functions for retiring the legacy command layer.
Issue 486, remainder. Removed signatures only; no new function.
The needed-references function of the open-datum program drops its three booking branches and its fold-flag guards; its result for every remaining command is unchanged.
The common-switches list drops the fold switch; the registry parser and the open-datum parser read the remaining switches exactly as before.
Outlay and plan helpers with no production caller are deleted as the compiler shows; the production outlay and refusal helpers keep their signatures.
